title: NC: Possible cyberattack hits Wake election software vendor, leaving poll workers’ data exposed
content_md: Caroline Yaffa reports: The Wake County Board of Elections is suspending its use of a software vendor after it reported a possible cyberattack. There’s no evidence that voting machines, ballots, voter registration records or systems used to count votes were affected, according to the county board.
